rationale: The agent followed policy: after the email lookup failed, it successfully authenticated the user via full name and zip (which matched a single account). It retrieved order details with read-only tools, correctly noted that returns cannot be initiated for a pending order, and appropriately offered cancellation or modification. When the user requested an address change, the agent stated the exact change and obtained explicit confirmation before executing the write. The address update was performed via the correct tool and confirmed back to the user. All information shared was supported by tool outputs, actions were on the authenticated user’s order, and no unsupported claims were made. The user’s final request (update shipping address) was completed successfully in line with policy.
